== Overview ==
{{spoiler|book=lh-03-the-knight|The Prime Arena, also known as the [[Prime Coliseum]], is a highly respected cultural institution located on the planet [[Visiria]]. It serves as a massive venue for combat, capable of hosting crowds of hundreds of thousands in person while reaching tens of millions more via [[Subline]] broadcasts. The facility features rubberized turf and is capable of triggering ancient magic, such as the appearance of glowing golden symbols, during matches. The arena is home to prestigious [[Champions]], including [[Albedon Pegarthus]] and [[Varic Vallenar]], and has hosted legendary figures like the [[Archmage]] [[Kyri Prest]]. Beyond its role as a combat site, the arena holds significant political weight; challenging its champions can be used as a method to demonstrate resolve or restore honor within the [[Karoshan Alliance]].}}

== The Knight ==
{{spoiler|book=lh-03-the-knight|The Prime Arena serves as a hallmark of the planet [[Visiria]]. This combat arena features state-of-the-art technology alongside battered bronze plates and is a grand sight visible through the Governor's room window. Within this space, mages compete to win rounds, and [[Albedon Pegarthus]] holds the position of [[Champion]]. Both Raion Raithe{{!}}Raion and Ryzer Raithe{{!}}Ryzer have been present at the location.}}
